Food, Service, Hygiene, Atmosphere - 5-Star Experience!
Jun 2023 • Family

The food tastes great. I praise the hygiene of the restaurant. The kitchen puts a lot of effort into the food presentation which makes the food more delicious than it already is. Let's also talk about the breathtaking view of the pool and the beach! Absolutely fascinating! I thank the service (I remember one of them is called 'Anh' who did such an excellent job) for adding up to the wonderful experience at "Rice Market". I will be back at this restaurant once I come back to Phu Quoc.

Delicious and wonderful service
Sep 2022
A warm welcome led by Ha at the entrance . The food was divine - couldn't fault it!!!! Service was excellent, very knowledgeable about food and very friendly

Breakfast !!! That will initially leave you lost. The breakfast includes Buffet and A la carte menu also. GEnerous meals!!!! You will find this is any Chinese and Vietnamese cuisine. Fresh prawn, juicy hargow to dip in soy sauce, curries, Bun Bo Hue and Wonton noodles and more .So impressed Banh Mi Vietnam delicate presentation, that why I tried 2 potions of it 😁 and Fresh Pantry where we got loads of healthy food, salad, cheese, ceareal. Highlights excellent fresh Bakery well prepared. Throughly enjoyed our meal. 

I would recommend to anyone as there's the signatures - that deservedly famous Peking Duck orderd, the chef presented and cut it in front of us. We used part of skin is eaten with a plum sauce and dip it (this was my favourite), the second was the tender sliced duck breast that went so well with the fried noodle. Should you try to be drizzle with Hoisin sauce and wrapped in their ultra thin wheat wrap which kept moist in the steamer the whole time. Definitely worth a visit and book in advance
